extraction.name: AMASS: Archive of Motion Capture as Surface Shapes
extraction.description: A large and varied database of human motion that unifies 15 different optical marker-based mocap datasets by representing them within a common framework and parameterization using the SMPL body model, DMPL dynamic shape space, and MANO hand model via the MoSh++ method. AMASS includes over 40 hours of motion data, spanning 346 subjects and 11,451 motions.
extraction.creator: Naureen Mahmood, Nima Ghorbani, Nikolaus F. Troje, Gerard Pons-Moll, Michael J. Black
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Data was aggregated by unifying 15 optical marker-based mocap datasets. Publicly available datasets were downloaded from the internet, while other datasets were obtained privately or recorded by the authors (Dancers, Transitions, BioMotionLab, and SSM). For the newly collected SSM dataset, an OptiTrack motion capture system with 24 Optitrack Prime 17W cameras and 67 reflective markers was synchronized with a 3dMD 4D body scanning system capturing at 60 fps with minimal clothing.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Physical data collection, Secondary Data analysis
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Marker occlusion occurs during mocap sessions due to body pose. A coefficient q is introduced to update the pose prior weight as a factor of the number of missing markers. Swapped and mislabeled markers were also present in source mocap data.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: 15 archival optical marker-based mocap datasets: ACCAD, BioMotion, CMU, EKUT, Eyes Japan, HumanEva, KIT, MPI HDM05, MPI Limits, MPI MoSh, SFU, SSM, TCD Hand, TotalCapture, and Transitions.
extraction.rai:dataImputationProtocol: When markers are occluded, a dynamic coefficient adjusts the pose prior weight by up to a factor of 3.5 depending on the fraction of missing markers to retain plausible poses; missing hand markers cause hand pose to default to the average MANO pose.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: MoSh++ maps sparse mocap markers into a unified SMPL body representation consisting of 16-dimensional shape parameters, 8-dimensional DMPL dynamic soft-tissue coefficients, and 159-dimensional pose parameters (including 24-D MANO hand articulation).
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: MoSh++ uses a two-stage optimization: Stage I optimizes body shape, latent marker positions, and poses across 12 randomly chosen frames using graduated optimization with Threshold Accepting; Stage II keeps shape and latent marker positions fixed while estimating per-frame pose and soft-tissue deformation parameters. Data with swapped and mislabeled markers was manually inspected, corrected, or held out.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset is hosted at http://amass.is.tue.mpg.de; the authors plan to continuously expand the dataset and incorporate more mocap data contributed by themselves and the community.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: MoSh++ is currently not real-time; does not capture facial motion or expressions; lack of ground-truth data for evaluating hand articulation accuracy; performance relies on optical tracking quality and calibration.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Animation, visualization, character motion synthesis, editing, generating synthetic training data for deep learning and computer vision tasks, and training models to denoise mocap data.
